summary.zh: 定位注册后首次体验中的流失环节并优化
summary.en: Find where new users drop off after signup and fix it

description.zh: 分析注册后到首次获得价值之间的路径，定位激活阶段的流失点并给出改动建议。适合首次体验转化偏低，或准备重做引导流程时使用。
description.en: Maps the path from signup to first value, finds where activation drops off and proposes concrete changes. Use it when first-run conversion is weak or before redesigning the onboarding flow.
